metadata.title: Global research data requirements and remaining skill gaps
metadata.geographic_requirement: Worldwide; no listing-market default. Match observations to company operating/customer/input exposure.
metadata.catalog_scope: Reusable source families and datasets across the twenty sector guides. A scoped requirements catalogue, not every possible vendor or a claim of complete live world coverage.
metadata.working_directory_review: Assessment of the eighteen bundled research skills and relevant references; no new live-agent benchmark was executed.
metadata.source_status: Official documentation/product/release pages reviewed. No new feed, subscription, API entitlement, bulk permission or production parser was established.
metadata.existing_adapters: The bundle contains adapters for AlphaPai, Alpha Vantage, API Ninjas and Massive. No credentials, universal country/field coverage or delivery rights are included; validate actual access before selecting a route.

sources.name: GLEIF Global LEI Index
sources.geography: Global legal entities; LEI coverage is not universal
sources.assumption_use: Resolve entities and parent/perimeter relationships before joining observations.
sources.limitation: An LEI identifies a legal entity, not a listed share class, ultimate beneficial owner or complete corporate-action history.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: OpenFIGI identifier mapping
sources.geography: Global instruments; mapping coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Keep the exact instrument separate from issuer identity.
sources.limitation: Ticker reuse and multiple matches need resolution; mappings alone do not supply historical constituents, delistings or corporate actions.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Official disclosure and regulator network
sources.geography: Worldwide through jurisdiction-specific official repositories
sources.delivery: Official filings, XBRL where offered, notices, issuer IR
sources.assumption_use: Create a common public issuer/peer baseline across the universe; retain original language, filing vintage and locators.
sources.limitation: This is a reusable public-disclosure pipeline, not proprietary company telemetry. SEC standard-tag aggregates do not contain every custom/segment KPI; non-US bulk access must be checked separately.
sources.status: Proposed reusable source network or functional requirement; cited example documentation located, complete country/product coverage not verified

sources.name: Global prices, actions, calendars and FX reference service
sources.geography: Required: intended exchanges and share classes worldwide; verify country by country
sources.access: Licensed delivery usually needed for broad consistent coverage
sources.delivery: One approved vendor/feed plus official exchange/issuer reconciliation
sources.assumption_use: Calculate comparable current/historical valuation and returns, including the actual instrument/currency.
sources.limitation: Procure or use an existing entitlement after a coverage trial. A desktop terminal or one working API route does not establish global bulk/history rights; adjusted prices cannot be mixed with separately added dividends.
sources.status: Proposed reusable source network or functional requirement; cited example documentation located, complete country/product coverage not verified

sources.name: World Bank WDI and related indicator datasets
sources.geography: Broad worldwide country coverage; individual series have gaps
sources.assumption_use: Structural market size, penetration ceilings and long-run scenarios.
sources.limitation: Annual development indicators are weak quarterly timing signals. Nominal, real, PPP and local-currency values are different quantities.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IMF topic datasets and WEO vintages
sources.geography: Worldwide, dataset and reporter coverage varies
sources.access: Public datasets; access terms per product
sources.assumption_use: Demand, currency/funding assumptions and country/regime scenarios.
sources.limitation: IFS indicators are now organized by topics; discover current dataset IDs rather than build around an obsolete IFS endpoint. WEO forecasts are forecasts, not actuals.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IMF DSBB / National Summary Data Pages / release calendars
sources.geography: Participating economies worldwide; country practices differ
sources.typical_frequency: Release calendar and underlying national frequencies
sources.delivery: Country metadata/NSDP links; SDMX where provided
sources.assumption_use: Bootstrap regional adapters globally and judge when an observation was actually available.
sources.limitation: A metadata directory is not a universal normalized feed, and an announced release date does not prove actual publication at that time.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: OECD Data Explorer
sources.geography: OECD plus partner economies; not every country
sources.access: Public subject to terms and limits
sources.assumption_use: Comparable demand, cycle and productivity benchmarks where the country/product is represented.
sources.limitation: Coverage and classifications vary by dataset; preserve survey definitions and vintage. OECD is not complete worldwide coverage.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: BIS credit, banking, property and FX statistics
sources.geography: Reporting economies worldwide; series-specific coverage
sources.assumption_use: Credit-cycle demand, funding stress, property and currency scenarios.
sources.limitation: Residence and consolidated banking bases differ. Aggregate credit does not determine one lender's growth or credit cost.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: UN Comtrade goods-trade datasets
sources.geography: Worldwide reporters/partners; missing periods and quantities vary
sources.access: Public preview; account/key and paid bulk tiers
sources.assumption_use: Product-specific demand, geographic exposure, trade diversion and supply-chain checks.
sources.limitation: FOB/CIF, re-exports, mirror data and HS revisions need reconciliation. Value per kg is a composition-sensitive unit value, not an issuer ASP. Use current My API portal.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WTO trade, tariffs and barometers
sources.geography: Worldwide/participating reporters; dataset coverage differs
sources.assumption_use: Global trade cycle, trade-cost changes and export-demand scenarios.
sources.limitation: A composite barometer is not a realized shipment count; tariff treatment needs exact product/origin/destination/effective-date mapping.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: UNIDO industrial production and manufacturing trade
sources.geography: Multi-country industrial datasets; country/industry coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Industrial demand, utilization-cycle and equipment-market calibration.
sources.limitation: Indices and country estimates are not plant utilization or unit demand. Retain ISIC/rebasing changes and estimated-versus-reported flags.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: ILOSTAT labor indicators
sources.geography: Worldwide labor statistics; country/series coverage differs
sources.delivery: Bulk downloads and documented web services
sources.assumption_use: Labor cost, capacity and household-demand priors.
sources.limitation: National wages do not equal a company's wage bill; occupation, location, overtime and currency mix matter. Modeled estimates differ from national observations.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: World Bank commodity prices / Pink Sheet
sources.geography: International reference commodities, not every local grade
sources.assumption_use: Input-cost and commodity-realization scenarios across sectors.
sources.limitation: Reference prices need grade, currency, freight, contract and inventory/hedging-lag bridges before entering company COGS.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: FAOSTAT production, trade and food/agriculture data
sources.geography: Broad worldwide country coverage; commodity/year gaps
sources.assumption_use: Agricultural supply, consumption and food-input scenarios.
sources.limitation: Harvest years, units, revision lags and country methods differ; annual balances do not establish a near-term retailer margin.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: FAO Food Price Index and food-price monitoring
sources.geography: International commodity baskets and selected local price series
sources.typical_frequency: Monthly; frequency varies for underlying markets
sources.access: Public releases; historical/reuse terms per dataset
sources.assumption_use: Consumer/food producer input-cost direction and inflation scenarios.
sources.limitation: A global basket is not the procurement mix or retail inflation of every country; convert through the matched product and pass-through mechanism.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Copernicus ERA5 climate reanalysis
sources.geography: Global gridded data; geographic and variable resolution matters
sources.assumption_use: Energy load, renewable generation, crop and weather-sensitive demand scenarios.
sources.limitation: Reanalysis is modeled historical weather; asset location, exposure and conversion models are still needed. Do not download every grid/variable by default.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WSTS / SIA semiconductor market data
sources.geography: Global semiconductor products and regions
sources.access: Public headline releases; detailed series licensed
sources.assumption_use: Chip-cycle demand, product/region mix and pricing calibration.
sources.limitation: SIA headlines use WSTS and often three-month moving averages: these are one underlying source, not independent corroboration. Product prices are not foundry wafer pricing.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: SEMI Market Intelligence / WWSEMS
sources.geography: Global semiconductor equipment/fab/wafer segments
sources.access: Selected public releases; granular history licensed
sources.assumption_use: Equipment demand, capacity additions and upstream cycle checks.
sources.limitation: Bookings, billings, shipments and announced capex are distinct. Confirm each report's definition, coverage and timing before joining datasets.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IDC global device and infrastructure trackers
sources.geography: Global/regional devices; product/country coverage by tracker
sources.assumption_use: Hardware units, replacement cycles and semiconductor end-demand checks.
sources.limitation: Shipments are not sell-through; preliminary/final estimates and tracker definitions differ. Detailed ASP/country history is not established by a public chart.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Gartner worldwide IT-spending estimates/forecasts
sources.geography: Global and selected country/category estimates
sources.access: Public release excerpts; detailed products licensed
collect: forecast vintage and constant/current currency basis
sources.assumption_use: Top-down IT budget priors and external scenario cross-checks.
sources.limitation: Much of this is an analyst estimate or forecast, not observed consumption. Keep it separate from actuals and avoid circularly validating our forecast with another forecast.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Cloudflare Radar
sources.geography: Global internet observations within Cloudflare's measurement population
sources.access: Public API with token/terms as documented
sources.assumption_use: Digital adoption, outages and broad activity checks.
sources.limitation: Network observations do not equal paid users, transactions, cloud revenue or platform market share; sampling and bots affect interpretation.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Similarweb web/app datasets
sources.geography: Multi-country web/app estimates; coverage varies by endpoint
sources.assumption_use: Audience/demand direction and relative channel behavior.
sources.limitation: Modeled visits do not establish purchases or revenue. Validate panel coverage, low-volume sites, methodology changes and cross-device duplication.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Sensor Tower mobile/digital intelligence
sources.geography: Multi-country/app-store coverage, with platform gaps
sources.assumption_use: Mobile platform and gaming adoption/monetization scenarios.
sources.limitation: Store consumer spend is not issuer net revenue. Mainland Android, third-party billing, refunds and platform coverage require explicit treatment.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WARC global advertising data and forecast vintages
sources.geography: Multi-market advertising; coverage by medium/market
sources.assumption_use: Advertising market growth and format/region mix.
sources.limitation: Gross/net spend, commissions and forecasts vary; no automatic mapping to one platform's impressions, CPM or take rate.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Ampere Analysis media and games research
sources.geography: International media/games products; country/platform coverage needs trial
sources.delivery: Request a sample schema/history and delivery terms
sources.assumption_use: Media demand, content competition and release/monetization priors.
sources.limitation: Product-level coverage/delivery is not verified here. Audience activity and third-party market estimates do not directly establish title profitability.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IMF Financial Soundness Indicators
sources.geography: Reporting economies; banking/NBFI indicators vary
sources.assumption_use: Banking/insurance credit-cycle and capital-risk priors.
sources.limitation: Consolidation bases, sector membership and accounting change. Country NPL/capital averages are not an individual institution's ratios.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Swiss Re sigma insurance research/explorer
sources.geography: Global country/region insurance markets; availability varies
sources.access: Public research/visualization; export/history rights to confirm
sources.delivery: Explorer/reports; licensed or approved downloads as available
sources.assumption_use: Industry premium growth, penetration and catastrophe/claims context.
sources.limitation: Aggregate market estimates do not reveal insurer underwriting quality, reserve adequacy or cash remittance. Separate historical estimates from forecasts.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: BIS CPMI payment statistics
sources.geography: CPMI reporting jurisdictions, not every country
sources.assumption_use: Digital payment adoption and total-payment-market development.
sources.limitation: Retail and wholesale payment flows differ; payment value is not processor revenue or net take rate. Cross-country definitions and coverage need alignment.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: World Federation of Exchanges statistics
sources.geography: Participating exchanges worldwide
sources.access: Public summaries; registered database access and terms
sources.assumption_use: Exchange/broker activity and capital-markets cycle assumptions.
sources.limitation: Single/double-counting conventions, on/off-exchange activity and exchange coverage differ; turnover is not net fund flow.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: ICI / IIFA fund assets and flows
sources.geography: Worldwide participating fund markets quarterly; separate US series at higher frequency
sources.access: Public releases; detailed history/subscription terms vary
sources.assumption_use: Asset-management AUM and flow scenarios, distinguishing market return from net subscriptions.
sources.limitation: Worldwide quarterly aggregates and US weekly series have different universes. Assets change with market returns/FX as well as flows.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: EPFR global fund flows and allocations
sources.geography: Participating global fund sample; universe varies
sources.assumption_use: Fund-management flow sensitivity and market-demand context.
sources.limitation: A fund sample is not all capital flows and may not identify ultimate investor activity or every ownership channel.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: JLL global and city-level property research
sources.geography: International cities/property types covered by JLL
sources.access: Public reports; structured/bulk data terms to confirm
sources.delivery: Report/download archive; agreed structured delivery if available
sources.assumption_use: Property operating assumptions by actual asset location and type.
sources.limitation: City samples, prime/average rents and valuation definitions differ. A global office average cannot forecast every REIT's rent.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: MSCI Real Assets / Real Estate data
sources.geography: International covered property markets; product-specific
sources.assumption_use: Property valuation, yield and transaction-cycle calibration.
sources.limitation: Appraisal smoothing, transaction selection and coverage matter; private-property indices are not listed REIT total returns or each asset's NAV.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WHO health indicators
sources.geography: Worldwide, indicator/country coverage differs
sources.delivery: Current WHO data services/downloads; verify migration from legacy APIs
sources.assumption_use: Addressable patient populations and structural healthcare demand.
sources.limitation: Incidence, prevalence, diagnosed, eligible and treated patients are different counts; country burden does not establish a drug's addressable paid market.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WHO Global Health Expenditure Database
sources.geography: Broad worldwide health-system coverage
sources.assumption_use: Healthcare funding and market-size priors.
sources.limitation: Lagged aggregate expenditure is not a provider's reimbursement rate, procedure mix or collectible cash.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov study registry
sources.geography: US registry with international studies; not all worldwide trials
sources.assumption_use: Trial activity, milestones and clinical/service-demand analysis.
sources.limitation: Registration/completion is not clinical success, regulatory approval or revenue. Sponsor/record selection and result-publication bias remain.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: WHO ICTRP international trial registry network
sources.geography: Participating registries worldwide
sources.access: Public search; export/access terms must be checked
sources.assumption_use: Broaden global clinical coverage and deduplicate trials registered in several systems.
sources.limitation: No universal unrestricted API is assumed. Duplicate registrations and reporting delays need entity/study matching.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Medicine/device regulator network; openFDA example
sources.geography: Local regulatory jurisdictions worldwide; FDA is US only
sources.access: Public official records; delivery varies by jurisdiction
sources.delivery: APIs where documented; official labels/reviews/approval notices
sources.assumption_use: Country-specific commercial eligibility, launch restrictions and regulatory milestones.
sources.limitation: US approval is not worldwide approval; labels and approvals are not clinical probabilities or prescription sales. Build country registries rather than extrapolate FDA coverage globally.
sources.status: Proposed reusable source network or functional requirement; cited example documentation located, complete country/product coverage not verified

sources.name: EPO OPS / WIPO PATENTSCOPE
sources.geography: International patent documents; jurisdictional legal status varies
sources.access: Public search; API registration, limits and reuse terms vary
sources.assumption_use: IP competition, technology exposure and exclusivity-research leads.
sources.limitation: A patent family or filing does not establish enforceable commercial exclusivity or a final expiration date; extensions, challenges and local rights need review.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IQVIA MIDAS and related market measurement
sources.geography: International pharmaceutical markets; product/channel/country coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Drug-market volume, share and price/mix calibration.
sources.limitation: Audit/ex-factory/list-price estimates are not necessarily net issuer revenue after rebates, returns and distribution; validate actual country coverage.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Citeline clinical and drug intelligence
sources.geography: International trial/drug intelligence; product-specific
sources.assumption_use: Pipeline competition, clinical-service activity and structured research priors.
sources.limitation: Curated intelligence is not a guarantee of complete or contemporaneous trial evidence; primary results and methodology still matter.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: NielsenIQ retail measurement
sources.geography: Covered retail/CPG markets internationally; channels/countries differ
sources.assumption_use: Consumer category volumes, price/mix and promotional intensity.
sources.limitation: Sample/extrapolation, online channels and informal trade vary by country. Panel value sales are not automatically manufacturer revenue.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Euromonitor Passport
sources.geography: International consumer/category markets; country/product coverage differs
sources.assumption_use: Consumer addressable-market, penetration and geographic-mix priors.
sources.limitation: Separate estimates/forecasts from observed data; category and currency definitions must match the model.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: International Coffee Organization
sources.geography: Global coffee market with origin/grade distinctions
sources.access: Public recent reports; some historical/detail datasets paid
sources.assumption_use: Coffee input-cost and supply-cycle scenarios.
sources.limitation: Do not assume all history is free; retail chains have procurement, hedging, processing and currency lags. Composite beans are not finished beverage COGS.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Off-Highway Research equipment-market data
sources.geography: International equipment markets; machine/country scope by product
sources.assumption_use: Machinery demand, product/geographic mix and replacement-cycle priors.
sources.limitation: Construction equipment does not cover all mining machinery, port equipment or oil/gas units. Do not transfer its growth rate across unrelated activities.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IFR World Robotics
sources.geography: Global industrial robots; national/application coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Automation investment, penetration and installed-base/service priors.
sources.limitation: Annual installations are not an integrator's orders or service revenue. Commercial delivery and granular history require confirmation.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: OICA motor-vehicle statistics
sources.geography: World production/sales reporters; country/category coverage differs
sources.access: Public official association tables; reuse terms apply
sources.assumption_use: Global auto market size, mix and manufacturing-cycle calibration.
sources.limitation: Production, wholesale, retail and registrations differ. OICA is not a complete timely monthly retail-sales feed for every country.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IEA Global EV Data Explorer
sources.geography: Covered global EV markets; metric/country detail varies
sources.access: Public selected explorer/download data; terms apply
sources.assumption_use: EV penetration, charging and battery-demand structural assumptions.
sources.limitation: Scenario projections are not actuals. Annual EV/battery demand cannot replace monthly OEM retail or supplier shipments.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: SNE Research battery usage
sources.geography: Reported global EV battery market; geography/powertrain definitions matter
sources.assumption_use: Battery end-demand, technology and regional market-share checks.
sources.limitation: Battery installed/used in vehicles sold is not cell production, shipments or energy-storage demand. Preserve the release's global/ex-country and cumulative definitions.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IEA energy datasets
sources.geography: International energy markets; dataset coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Energy demand, transition, supply constraints and capital-investment scenarios.
sources.limitation: Do not assume every IEA dataset is free or has the same commercial-use license; data estimates and outlook scenarios need separate status.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: JODI Oil and Gas World Databases
sources.geography: Reporting countries worldwide; availability/quality differs
sources.assumption_use: Physical energy balances and inventory-cycle assumptions.
sources.limitation: Missing data, revisions and stock/flow units need handling. A world total can change because reporter coverage changed.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: EIA energy data including international series
sources.geography: US high-frequency data plus distinct international datasets
sources.delivery: Documented API v2 and bulk resources
sources.assumption_use: Fuel-cost, energy balance and benchmark-market scenarios.
sources.limitation: US weekly inventories are US observations, not a global balance. Geography, benchmark, products and data lags differ across international series.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IRENA capacity, generation and cost statistics
sources.geography: Worldwide power technologies; country/year coverage differs
sources.assumption_use: Power-capacity mix, renewable investment and structural generation scenarios.
sources.limitation: Installed capacity is not effective output. Cost benchmarks are not the specific project's tariff, financing cost or funded return.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Ember electricity datasets
sources.geography: Broad international country coverage, not every country/month
sources.access: Open data; comply with dataset license/attribution
sources.assumption_use: Power demand, dispatch mix and fuel/renewable generation checks.
sources.limitation: Historical formats changed in July 2026. National generation does not identify a utility's realized price, hedging or regulated return.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: USGS global mineral statistics
sources.geography: International mineral production/reserves; commodity detail varies
sources.delivery: Mineral Commodity Summaries and statistics downloads
sources.assumption_use: Mineral supply concentration, capacity and long-run balance priors.
sources.limitation: Annual country reserves/production do not reveal mine grade, recovery, depletion or a company's sustaining capex.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: worldsteel steel production and industry data
sources.geography: Reporting steel-producing countries; product/country scope differs
sources.access: Public selected tables; fuller history licensed
sources.assumption_use: Steel demand/supply cycle and upstream iron-ore/coal/equipment priors.
sources.limitation: Crude steel is not steel consumption, finished-product prices or a miner's sales. Current public tables do not establish free full history.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: LME reference prices, inventories and market data
sources.geography: Exchange metal contracts; globally relevant but specific grades/locations
sources.access: Selected public display; historical/bulk use commonly licensed
sources.delivery: Official or approved licensed data delivery
sources.assumption_use: Metal realization/input costs and inventory/curve scenarios.
sources.limitation: Exchange warehouse stocks are not all physical inventory. Contract, premium, location, currency and tenor must match; bulk/history rights require confirmation.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Fastmarkets commodity assessments
sources.geography: International commodity/grade/location coverage by product
sources.delivery: Contracted price/history delivery; verify benchmark use rights
sources.assumption_use: Matched product pricing and cost-pass-through assumptions where exchange prices are insufficient.
sources.limitation: Assessed benchmarks have market-specific samples and methodology; a benchmark quote is not a company's transaction price.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: ITU DataHub ICT indicators
sources.geography: Worldwide ICT indicators; country/series coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Telecom adoption, capacity and structural revenue-pool priors.
sources.limitation: Subscriptions are not unique people; standardized price baskets are not billed ARPU. The old separately sold WT/ICT database was discontinued; use the current hub.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: GSMA Intelligence
sources.geography: International mobile operators/markets; product coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Mobile market size, technology transitions and cross-market operating benchmarks.
sources.limitation: Verify ARPU/connection/country definitions and actual historical data rights; forecasts are not actual adoption.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IATA air passenger/cargo statistics
sources.geography: Global/regional airline reporting population; detailed coverage varies
sources.access: Public analysis summaries; granular traffic/rate products commercial
sources.assumption_use: Airline/airport demand, capacity and utilization-cycle assumptions.
sources.limitation: Traffic, capacity, yield and cash receipts are distinct. Regional aggregates are not an individual route network's fares or airline margins.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: UNCTAD maritime and trade indicators
sources.geography: International ports/countries and shipping networks
sources.access: Public summaries/data; check underlying data rights
sources.assumption_use: Shipping network structure, capacity and long-term trade/demand priors.
sources.limitation: Connectivity is not utilization, port throughput or freight price. Some indicators rely on an underlying licensed provider.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: IMF PortWatch
sources.geography: Covered ports/chokepoints worldwide; algorithmic coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Trade disruption, port utilization and logistics timing scenarios.
sources.limitation: AIS-derived trade estimates are modeled observations, not audited customs/port actuals. Preserve model versions, coverage and nowcast status.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Baltic Exchange freight indices
sources.geography: Specified dry-bulk/tanker/container routes, not every cargo market
sources.access: Selected public headlines; historical/data delivery licensed
sources.assumption_use: Freight revenue/cost and shipping-cycle assumptions.
sources.limitation: Do not apply a dry-bulk index to container shipping or treat a composite spot index as an issuer's contracted realized yield.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: Drewry World Container Index and shipping research
sources.geography: Specified container trade lanes; other products have different scope
sources.access: Public current index/research excerpts; historical/detailed delivery licensed
sources.assumption_use: Container freight, export cost and logistics scenarios.
sources.limitation: Route mix, contract versus spot, surcharges and FEU/TEU units need matching. Do not assume public charts permit automated history redistribution.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: UN Tourism indicators
sources.geography: Global/country tourism statistics; metric availability varies
sources.access: Public selected dashboards; detailed data access varies
sources.assumption_use: Travel, hotel, airport and tourism-exposed consumer demand.
sources.limitation: Arrivals are not unique travelers or hotel room nights; currency, border definitions and country reporting gaps matter.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: CoStar / STR hotel benchmarking
sources.geography: International participating hotel markets; sample/property coverage varies
sources.assumption_use: Hotel demand, room pricing and local supply-cycle assumptions.
sources.limitation: Benchmark samples and restatements change; owner/franchise/manager revenue and profit are not hotel-level room revenue.
sources.status: Primary documentation or product/release page located; dataset trial still required

sources.name: FactSet Estimates / LSEG I/B/E/S
sources.geography: Intended global issuer universe; broker, metric and period coverage require trial
sources.delivery: Licensed API/feed/export with point-in-time capability specifically confirmed
sources.assumption_use: Map expectations and quantify our assumption/earnings differences on matched bases.
